'''Darth Thanaton's meditation chamber''' was the personal chambers of [[Darth Thanaton]]. The chambers consisted of many rooms, however, its greatest detail was the large room in the middle, with a platform and many large [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] statues around it.

==History==
The [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chambers]] of [[Darth Thanaton]] were only accessible to Thanaton's followers and students. There, the various apprentices and Thanaton himself [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]] over the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] confronted Thanaton after the latter tried to have the young Sith killed. Kallig killed [[Rolan (Human)|Rolan]], one of Thanaton's apprentices in a duel. After Thanaton was killed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Kallig took over the Chambers.
